question: Obtain the relation between half-life $T_{1/2}$ and decay constant $\lambda$ for a radioactive substance.

options.A: From $N=N_0e^{-\lambda t}$, at $t=T_{1/2}$, $N=N_0/2$. Thus $\frac12=e^{-\lambda T_{1/2}}$, so $\lambda T_{1/2}=\ln2$ and $T_{1/2}=\frac{\ln2}{\lambda}=\frac{0.693}{\lambda}$.
